mainEntity.name: What is a founder thought leadership agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A founder thought leadership agency builds the point of view, content and media footprint that make you the cited authority in your category. It is for Web3, AI, DePIN and cybersecurity founders who want to be the name investors, journalists and potential hires surface when they ask who leads the space. Shilika Jain runs this directly for $5K–$12K/month, covering op-ed ghostwriting, outlet placement and the author-entity build that AI engines cite. It is not content marketing: it is earned authority.

mainEntity.name: How much does founder thought leadership cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator running a full programme, including ghostwriting, outlet pitching and entity build, costs $5K–$12K per month. A focused founder profiling sprint, four to eight weeks with defined deliverables, runs $15K–$40K. Traditional PR agencies charge $15K–$45K per month for an account team where the senior person often does not write. The fractional model gives you the senior operator doing the actual work at half the agency cost.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you place my op-eds and interviews in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto and tech: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks, AI Magazine. Mainstream business press where the angle is strong: Forbes, Benzinga, Yahoo Finance. Regional tech: Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA), CryptoTimes JP (Japan). Placement depends on a genuine editorial angle, not a wire blast or paid placement. Earned bylines in these outlets are what AI citation engines treat as authority signals.

mainEntity.name: How long before I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first placed op-ed or interview typically lands within four to six weeks of kick-off, once the point of view is defined and outlet relationships are mapped. Consistent AI citation, where ChatGPT or Perplexity surfaces your name by default, builds over three to six months as the author-entity compounds. The fastest results come from founders who have a genuine contrarian view and are willing to publish under their own name, not a brand account.

Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a read on your current media footprint and where the gaps are, or book a 30-minute call and we will plot the POV and first three op-ed angles live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
